import bpy
from mathutils import Vector
c=bpy.data.collections['Pier_Working'];c.hide_viewport=False
for o in c.objects:o.hide_set(False)

 if o.name.startswith(('Deck','WaterPile','Pile')):
  if 'pin' in o.name:continue
  pts=[o.matrix_world@Vector(v) for v in o.bound_box]
  print(o.name,'local',tuple(round(v,4) for v in o.location),'bounds',tuple(round(min(p[i] for p in pts),4) for i in range(3)),tuple(round(max(p[i] for p in pts),4) for i in range(3)),'uv',[(u.name) for u in o.data.uv_layers], 'mats',[m.name for m in o.data.materials])
